title: SPDT
text: Single pole double throw switch, 1 input, {Port terminations (Ohm)} sets Port terminations; {Threshold voltage}, {Characterization}, {On resistance}, {Off resistance}, {Insertion loss (dB)}, {Isolation (dB)} sets the isolation value, {Loading type} and {Ground and hide reference terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Port terminations (Ohm)
params.values: Port terminations 50 (default) | scalar | vector of size 1-by-3

params.name: Ground and hide reference terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
